direction: Commercial-inspired independent literary Greek revision; no foundry authorship claim
construction: Glyph-specific smooth vector fields reconstruct native curves with counter-specific modulation; original source optical masters independently treated. No raster trace, global width formula or outline dilation.
retention_reason: Native forms already articulate stems, diagonals and distinct kappa variant. Preserving them controls the literary family rhythm; especially psi scripts keep fragile native open arms.

shape_actions.α: Asymmetric pear-like inner space: fuller lower left, compact upper shoulder, shorter lower right exit; counter adjusted independently.
shape_actions.β: Unequal bowl redraw: compact upper bowl, generous lower bowl and disciplined waist; script roles keep waist softer.
shape_actions.γ: Flowing shoulder moved forward through mid-body while keeping native descending gesture.
shape_actions.δ: Fuller lower bowl against a restrained returning upper stroke.
shape_actions.ε: Open aperture and subtly differentiated opposing horizontal terminals, native epsilon identity.
shape_actions.ζ: Three-stage directional movement through restrained upper, waist and lower turns.
shape_actions.η: Gentle opening of the native shoulder without erasing stem/descender distinction.
shape_actions.θ: Roomier oval counter and broad body against exact native horizontal identity.
shape_actions.ν: Curved middle gesture and quieter upper departure, native asymmetric thick/thin logic distinct from Latin v.
shape_actions.ξ: Three articulated serpentine turns, upper forward departure, recessed central turn, clear lower return.
shape_actions.ο: Slightly pear-shaped living counter with compact shoulder and fuller lower space.
shape_actions.ρ: Rounder upper bowl and independently expanded counter against the intact descending stem.
shape_actions.ς: Native final-sigma return retained with controlled lower/upper asymmetry.
shape_actions.σ: Restrained rounded body with open upper shoulder, final sigma remains separately recognized.
shape_actions.υ: Generous round basin and gently narrowed upper shoulder; pass2 restores depth after pass1 flattened the basin.
shape_actions.φ: Roomier oval around straight native stem, counters independently eased.
shape_actions.ω: Broader low paired bowls with a composed lower central join; pass2 raises join modestly for less sag.
shape_actions.ϵ: Distinct conventional lunate epsilon retained through restrained aperture/terminal redraw.
shape_actions.ϑ: Native looped theta variant kept distinct, oval counter opened without merging into ordinary theta.
shape_actions.ϕ: Separate phi variant: counter opening and oval balance while retaining conventional stem/topology.
shape_actions.ϱ: Distinct returning rho terminal and upper oval expanded carefully.
shape_actions.ϖ: Native curled pi variant keeps semantic skeleton, broader basin and controlled central join.
shape_actions.∂: Fuller lower bowl with restrained returning upper stroke; distinct from delta.

adopted_helpers: tools/greek_proofs.py pass1-only rendering helpers; final uses tools/arena_proofs.py
